_frame: CAD frame (+Y up). Body origin O_b = hull volume centroid. v_r = body velocity relative to water, expressed in CAD axes. Water velocity seen by the body = -v_r (translation) ; omega = body angular velocity about O_b.

dropped_rotation._note: kim 2026-10-20: steady-rotation cases dropped (no steady state: MRF closed box spins up, MRF abs. walls drift, transient 2 rad still decaying). Rotational linear damping Dl_p/q/r comes from the velocity-phase part of O_p/O_q/O_r; Dq_p/q/r fixed to 0.

oscillation._note: whole-domain rigid mesh motion, open (pressure-outlet) box faces, x(t)=X0 sin(2 pi t/T), 3 periods, last 2 used
